preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call withdrawalBNB(uint256 _amount, address to) to drain all BNB from the contract, or call withdrawalToken(address _tokenAddr, uint _amount, address to) to drain any ERC20 tokens held by the contract. The owner can also disable trading via setSwapEnabled(false) to prevent users from selling, then extract funds. Additionally, the owner can modify fee percentages to maximum values and change marketing/liq wallet addresses to their own to capture all transaction fees.
